name: Woebot Health

strategic_pivot.change: Consumer app discontinued; pivoted entirely to enterprise B2B model
strategic_pivot.reason: Focus on payer, provider, and health-system licensing over DTC subscriptions

short_description: AI-powered conversational mental health platform with FDA Breakthrough Device designation for postpartum depression. Enterprise-focused with 15 RCTs and B2B/payer licensing model.
long_description: Woebot Health is a clinical-grade AI mental health platform that uses a rule-based conversational chatbot (not generative AI) to deliver evidence-based therapeutic techniques including CBT, DBT, and IPT. The company received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2021 for WB001, its investigational digital therapeutic for postpartum depression, and has been conducting pivotal clinical trials. In June 2025, Woebot discontinued its direct-to-consumer app to focus entirely on enterprise partnerships with payers, providers, and health systems. The platform is backed by 15+ randomized controlled trials showing effect sizes of d=0.57 for anxiety and d=0.46 for depression. Enterprise revenue comes from Per Member Per Month (PMPM) subscriptions and per-treatment cycle fees ($200-$450). Notable partnerships include Akron Children's Hospital for adolescent mental health. The 2025 Open Access API enables third-party healthcare apps to embed Woebot's conversational interface.

faqs.q: Is the Woebot app still available?
faqs.a: No, Woebot discontinued its direct-to-consumer app on June 30, 2025. The company pivoted entirely to enterprise partnerships with payers, providers, and health systems.
Woebot received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2021 for WB001 (postpartum depression treatment) but is still conducting pivotal clinical trials. It is not yet FDA cleared.

faqs.q: How effective is Woebot according to clinical trials?
faqs.a: A 2024 systematic review found effect sizes of d=0.57 for anxiety and d=0.46 for depression across 15+ Woebot RCTs, which is respectable for a digital intervention.
Woebot uses rule-based conversational AI (not generative AI) to deliver CBT, DBT, and IPT therapeutic techniques through an engaging chat interface.
